## What's Changed

- Publishes the Local Media album index's final selected artwork on every track
  returned by the Tater music catalog.
- Keeps album covers consistent across manual selections, embedded artwork,
  local cover files, and artwork scraped through MusicBrainz and Cover Art
  Archive.
- Enables Music Core and Little Spud clients to display the same album artwork
  selected in Tater Tube Server.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No database migration is required. Music Core should refresh its catalog after
upgrading; run a manual catalog sync if you want the new artwork immediately.
